description: Copy an existing diagram (including one that is public but not yours) into a new diagram you own. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

diagram_id.description: Diagram id — from list_diagrams or create_diagram.

name.description: Name for the copy. Default: "<original name> (copy)".

name: duplicate_diagram
